name: text-to-design-ui
description: text-to-design 的设计工具插件包(jsDesign / Figma / MasterGo):构建产物含 ui.html + code.js + manifest.json,导入即用

scripts.dev: concurrently "vite" "vite build --mode jsdesign --watch" "vite build --mode figma --watch" "vite build --mode mastergo --watch"
scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vite build && vite build --mode jsdesign && vite build --mode figma && vite build --mode mastergo
